subject: maths
question: The average of 25 numbers is 64. The averages of the first 13 numbers and that of the last 13 numbers are 62.8 and 72.2, respectively. If the 12th number is 61, and if the 12th and 13th numbers are excluded, then what is the average of the remaining numbers (correct to one decimal place)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net deviation of 26 numbers (first 13 + last 13) from the original average 64:

Deviation = 13 × (62.8 − 64) + 13 × (72.2 − 64) = 13 × (−1.2 + 8.2) = 13 × 7 = 91.

Since the 13th number is counted twice, 13th number = 64 + 91 = 155.

Sum of 12th and 13th numbers = 61 + 155 = 216.

New Average = (Total Sum − 216) ÷ (25 − 2) = (1600 − 216) ÷ 23 = 1384 ÷ 23 ≈ 60.2.

**∴ The correct answer is 60.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Average of 25 numbers = 64 | Avg of first 13 = 62.8 | Avg of last 13 = 72.2 | 12th number = 61.

**Formula:** Sum = Average × Count

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0aafe4dee0d72bb0345a9a0205966f39238f863ea7457bd1ff8e13728031a1f6.png] 

⇒ Total sum of 25 numbers = 25 × 64 = 1600

⇒ Sum of first 13 numbers = 13 × 62.8 = 816.4

⇒ Sum of last 13 numbers = 13 × 72.2 = 938.6

⇒ Sum of (1 to 13) + (13 to 25) = 816.4 + 938.6 = 1755

⇒ 13th number = 1755 − 1600 = 155

⇒ Sum of excluded numbers (12th + 13th) = 61 + 155 = 216

⇒ Sum of remaining 23 numbers = 1600 − 216 = 1384

⇒ Average of remaining numbers = 1384 ÷ 23 ≈ 60.173

**∴ The correct answer is 60.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Deviation Method for Overlap

When one middle number is common in two groups, its value = Original Average + Total Deviation from the groups.

Exclusion Average Formula

New Average = (Initial Sum − Sum of Excluded Items) ÷ (Initial Count − Number of Excluded Items).

Weighted Average

The combined average of two groups is given by (n₁×A₁ + n₂×A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).</p
